title: SPEC
description: Product. Intent turned into criteria that are executable, because QA cannot grade prose.

serves.description: Two queues and only two, same as Engineering. A spec serving neither is a preference with a document around it, and the evidence chain is broken where nobody looks.

link.description: Which link of the hypothesis chain this spec buys evidence for. Without it, 'we shipped and usage was low' cannot separate a wrong mechanism from a bad implementation.

executable.description: A command, a request, or an assertion. If this cannot be written, the criterion is not ready.

outOfScope.description: Explicit non-goals, so QA does not invent scope.
